goal: Raise clinical-truth recall on the frozen synthetic holdout without sacrificing precision, provenance, reviewability or the blocked production boundary.
constraints: Do not access identifiable patient data.
done_when: Recall improves materially on the frozen holdout.
Precision and safety invariants do not regress.
Remaining false negatives are classified and reviewable.

failures.detail: Current frozen-holdout recall is insufficient to advance the proof ladder.

next_step: Classify the frozen-holdout false negatives, implement the smallest recall improvement, and rerun the exact holdout before considering any clinician-evaluation step.

decision_estimate.rationale: The recall gate blocks the next proof stage, but the work is more investigation-heavy than the current unblocked A2 opportunities elsewhere in the portfolio.
